descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S03 「公开的保留声明和 OAT-04 写的完全一样」 The published retention claim reads exactly as OAT-04 states

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U14 The retention claim reads exactly: 'Live Hospital patient data is deleted within 36 hours; encrypted backups are kept up to 7 days for disaster recovery.'（UAT OAT-04 Expected 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Every place a retention statement is published (which places count is Q14)

When Compare each statement with the OAT-04 sentence word for word

Then Each reads 'Live Hospital patient data is deleted within 36 hours; encrypted backups are kept up to 7 days for disaster recovery.' and none promises anything different

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Exact text match with UAT OAT-04 Expected 3: a different number or wording = Fail; the claim published nowhere = Fail
